issue_context.title: Bug: Thumbnails don't refresh in OneDrive after being cached
issue_context.body:
### Description

Thumbnails don't refresh in OneDrive after being cached

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Clear thumbnail cache in Windows
2. Open OneDrive location with images
3. Notice how only icons are displayed
4. Wait a second and then refresh the location, notice that the thumbnails are now displayed

### Requirements

- Refetch the thumbnail if the initial result was an icon

### Files Version

v3.1.1

### Windows Version

Windows 11

### Log File

NA
